text_block_list.text:
One day, after Bamboo Memory's Senior 
Class year reached a turning point...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Bamboo Memory-san. Pardon the 
interruption during your training—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san! That's rare to see! Did 
something happen?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I've come bearing good news for the 
two of you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Good news...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the URA has officially decided 
to honor Bamboo Memory-san as the "Best 
Sprint/Mile Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes! Congratulations to both of you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WE DID IT WE DID IT WE DID IT WE DID 
IT—!!! WOOOOOOOOO—!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm... the "Best Sprinter Umamusume"!!! 
Woohoo-!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: AWESOMEーーーーーー!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu— Perhaps you're just overjoyed?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've become... the absolute strongest, 
greatest sprinter Umamusume!! 
WOOOOOAAAAAHHHH-!!

Bamboo Memory shouted with joy at full 
sprint, tears flyingâ

text_block_list.name: Tracksuit-Clad Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory-senpai is winning the Best 
Sprinter Umamusume award! That's so 
awesome~!

text_block_list.name: Tracksuit-Clad Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Her performance in the Sprinters Stakes 
was amazing too. ...Still, Bamboo's voice 
is ridiculously loud. It's echoing all 
across the course."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Truly, a joyous occasion... I must share 
this with Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I cannot afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, look at you getting all excited. At 
this rate, it looks like it'll be even 
noisier than usual back in our room today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ......Congrats, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —We ought to celebrate for them.

—And so, word of Bamboo Memory's 
monumental achievement spread in the blink 
of an eye.

And a few days later, at the awards 
ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory-san, congratulations on 
winning the Best Sprinter award!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!! Really! Truly, truly!! 
It's an honor!!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
With that fierce battle in the recent Mile 
Championship, Bamboo Memory-san is truly 
one of the Umamusume this era has its eyes 
on right now!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us about your goals and 
aspirations for your future races, Bamboo 
Memory-san?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. In that case, let 
me take this chance to speak my mind!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I've truly proven that I'm the 
ultimate and most marvelous Umamusume at 
short distances!! However—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's only how it is right now!! There's 
no telling what I'll be like in the 
future, not at all!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I won't just settle for today! I'm gonna 
burn even hotter so I can be crowned 'Best 
Sprinter/Miler' again next year, no doubt 
about it!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"To all the Umamusume running sprints 
right now!!! And to every Umamusume aiming 
to run sprints, I make this declaration!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Putting the title of the absolute 
strongest on the line— Take on me, Bamboo 
Memory!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Run with me in the absolute best race, one 
that becomes everyone's "dream"!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Blaze upーー!! Twinkle Serieeeeees!!!!"

And so, Bamboo Memory's declaration 
greatly heightened everyone's anticipation 
for the unseen races yet to come...!
